label: heart-s0
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Two input splits (restecg:2, slope:2). 3598 and 1650 take input from gate 665 so live only in the flat_slope_amplifier composition. Inner restecg:2 ReLUs 2349, 2771 never clip (affine). Relay 2447 near-inert (logit SD 0.026). Gate evidence rests on only 8 active train rows: specificity solid, clinical meaning weakly supported.
tool_bugs: Root validation failed with grandchild entry nodes, so they were left out of the root entry list. get_formula shows output as ReLU; agent reports train AUC 0.945 = AUC(z) while sigmoid(relu(z)) gives 0.912. compute_shap >120s, tiny nonzero SHAP (1e-5) on disconnected inputs (kernel-SHAP noise).
summary: Essentially logistic regression over 17 inputs (logit SD 4.33) plus one sparse nonlinear correction: gate 665 is an exact AND of female, exercise angina and no LVH, firing on 8/242 train rows (7 positive); a flat-slope ReLU amplifies it super-additively (node 1650 values 0, 0.446, 2.10, 6.09; gate+flat slope 7/7 positive). Removing the amplifier: train AUC 0.945 -> 0.930.
